definition_zh: 任性；突发奇想；反复无常的念头
definition_en: a sudden, unpredictable change of mood or behavior; an impulsive whim
core_image: 一阵说转就转的旋风：天空晴着晴着忽然翻脸
scene: 画廊里，收藏家昨天还非这幅画不买，今天却看也不看。Her purchase of the vineyard was pure caprice.
sceneCN: 这里 caprice 是「一时兴起」（第 1 个义项：无端起意、不讲理由的突发念头）；句意是她买下那座葡萄园纯属一时兴起。

pos.zh: 反复无常；（命运、天气的）变幻莫测

derivatives.zh: 由 caprice 加形容词后缀构成，义为「反复无常的；任性的」
同根音乐术语，义为「随想地；自由奔放地」（意大利语）

senses.title: A sudden unaccountable change of mind
senses.definition: an impulsive wish or change of intention without apparent reason
senses.definitionCN: 没有明显缘由的冲动愿望或主意突变
senses.example: She dyed her hair silver on a caprice.
senses.exampleCN: 她一时兴起把头发染成了银色。
senses.why: The older image is the goat's sudden leap: the mind jumps without warning.
senses.whyCN: 较早的意象是山羊的突然跃起：心思毫无征兆地一跳。

senses.title: Unpredictable changeability of things
senses.definition: the quality of being governed by chance or unpredictable swings, as weather or fortune
senses.definitionCN: 受偶然支配或摇摆不定的性质，如天气或运气
senses.example: Sailors know the caprice of the southern ocean.
senses.exampleCN: 水手们深知南大洋的变幻无常。
senses.why: What people do by caprice, nature seems to do by caprice too.
senses.whyCN: 人会任性无常，大自然看起来也是如此。

senses.title: A whimsical musical or artistic piece
senses.definition: a lively, free-form instrumental piece following the player's fancy, as a caprice
senses.definitionCN: 随演奏者兴致而作的活泼自由器乐曲，即随想曲
senses.example: Paganini's caprices for solo violin remain legendary.
senses.exampleCN: 帕格尼尼的小提琴随想曲至今仍是传奇。
senses.why: Music that leaps where it pleases borrows the goat's leap as its form.
senses.whyCN: 随心所欲跳跃的音乐借用了山羊一跃而起的形态。

intro.en: Caprice entered European languages through Italian capriccio, probably from capro, he-goat, suggesting the goat's sudden start; the precise path is debated.
intro.cn: caprice 经意大利语 capriccio 进入欧洲各语言，一般认为出自 capro（公山羊），暗指山羊的突然起跳；具体路径尚有争议。

items.en: The root *kapro- is associated with the he-goat, seen in Latin caper and capra.
items.cn: 词根 *kapro- 与公山羊相关，见于拉丁语 caper、capra。

items.en: Latin caper meant he-goat; capra meant she-goat, source of Capricorn.
items.cn: 拉丁语 caper 意为公山羊；capra 意为母山羊，Capricorn（摩羯座）即出于此。

items.en: Italian capriccio meant a sudden start like a goat's shudder, then a whim, then a free-form piece of music.
items.cn: 意大利语 capriccio 先指如山羊惊跳般的突发举动，继而指一时怪念，再指自由曲式的乐曲。

items.en: French caprice carried it into English in the seventeenth century with the whim and changeability senses.
items.cn: 十七世纪法语 caprice 携「怪念」与「无常」二义进入英语。

items.en: Today it labels impulsive choices, fickle weather and fortune, and Paganini's showpieces.
items.cn: 如今它形容一时兴起的决定、善变的天气与命运，以及帕格尼尼式的炫技曲。

note.en: Caprice stands with its goat relatives and a row of temperament words.
note.cn: caprice 与山羊词族的亲戚以及一排性格词汇站在一起。

entries.definition: Given to sudden changes of mood or behavior.
The goat sign of the zodiac, from the same Latin caper.
entries.definitionCN: 黄道山羊座，同出拉丁语 caper。

entries.definition: The Italian musical piece painted or played in free fantasy.
entries.definitionCN: 意大利语的随想曲或幻想题材画作。

entries.definition: Exact and careful; rhymes with caprice but utterly different in meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 精确的，与 caprice 押韵而语义几乎相反。

entries.definition: A sudden wish to do something without serious reason.
entries.definitionCN: 无严肃理由的一时念头。
（忠诚或情感上的）善变不可靠。

entries.definition: The unwelcome changes of fortune over time.
Playful, quaint oddity of ideas, lighter than caprice.
entries.definitionCN: 古灵精怪的趣味，语感比 caprice 轻快。

entries.definition: Steadfast reliability and sameness of purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 坚定可靠、始终如一，是 caprice 的反义对照。

normalIntro.en: Five hooks on the goat story and the weather-turning image.
normalIntro.cn: 五条围绕「山羊」典故与「天色骤变」画面的记忆钩子。

normal.en: Goat story: Italian capro, he-goat, gives the sudden leap behind caprice.
normal.cn: 山羊典故：意大利语 capro（公山羊）给出 caprice 背后那记突然起跳。

normal.en: Zodiac link: Capricorn the goat and caprice the goat-leap share caper, capra.
normal.cn: 星座关联：摩羯座的羊与 caprice 的羊同出 caper、capra。

normal.en: Music hook: Paganini wrote twenty-four Caprices; the noun names the piece too.
normal.cn: 音乐钩子：帕格尼尼写了二十四首随想曲；这个名词也指这种曲子。

normal.en: Adjective twin: capricious is the standard SAT partner of caprice.
normal.cn: 形容词孪生：capricious 是 caprice 在 SAT 里的标准搭档。

normal.en: Phrase frame: the caprice of fate is the literary way to blame luck.
normal.cn: 短语框架：the caprice of fate 是文学里归咎运气的说法。

abstract.en: A goat on a hillside turning mid-bite, bolting toward the ridge for no visible reason.
abstract.cn: 山坡上一只山羊正吃着草，忽然扭头向山脊狂奔，看不出任何理由。

abstract.en: Blue sky at breakfast, black clouds by noon, sun again by three.
abstract.cn: 早餐时晴空万里，正午乌云压顶，下午三点又艳阳高照。

abstract.en: A violin leaping across the strings wherever it pleases.
abstract.cn: 一把小提琴随心所欲地在弦上跳跃。

examples.en: The committee's verdict seemed governed by caprice rather than rules.
examples.cn: 委员会的裁决似乎凭一时好恶，而非依规而行。

examples.en: At the market she bought a parrot on a caprice.
examples.cn: 在集市上，她一时兴起买了一只鹦鹉。

examples.en: Vines suffer under the caprice of spring frosts.
examples.cn: 葡萄园饱受春季霜冻无常之苦。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克普瑞斯」——可（克）惜计划（普）锐（瑞）意取消（斯），说变就变，正是任性反复；联想山羊想吃就吃、想跳就跳，全凭心血来潮。

root: 一般认为经意大利语 capriccio（山羊的惊跳；怪念）进入欧洲语言，词基为拉丁语 caper / capra（公山羊／母山羊），可上溯至与山羊相关的词根 *kapro-。十七世纪经法语 caprice 进入英语，义为「一时怪念」「反复无常」，后亦指自由曲式的随想曲。同根词有 capricious、Capricorn；词源路径在细节上仍有争议。

sensesIntro.en: From the goat's sudden leap the word covers impulsive choices, fickle fortune, and free-form music.
sensesIntro.cn: 从山羊的突然一跳出发，词义涵盖冲动之举、无常的命运与自由曲式的音乐。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a goat leaping sideways for no reason anyone can see.
core.cn: 核心意象：一只旁若无由、横跳而起的山羊。

branches.en: THE DECISION: choices made on no ground but mood.
branches.cn: 决定：全凭情绪、毫无根据的选择。

branches.en: THE SKY: weather and fortune as moody masters.
branches.cn: 天空：把天气与命运看作善变的主宰。

branches.en: THE STAGE: music that obeys only the player's fancy.
branches.cn: 舞台：只听命于演奏者兴致的乐曲。

branches.en: THE BLAME: caprice as the name for what cannot be predicted or held to account.
branches.cn: 归咎：凡无法预测、无法追责者，皆名之曰 caprice。

branches.en: THE CHARM: the same word allowed to mean delightful spontaneity.
branches.cn: 魅力：同一个词也可以指讨喜的随性。

intro.en: Caprice is a borrowed noun without English affixes; its derivational life sits in the goat family and the Italian musical form.
intro.cn: caprice 是整体借入的名词，不带英语固有词缀；其派生活动在山羊词族与意大利音乐体裁之中。

latinIntro.en: The caper goat root reaches from zodiac charts to violin showpieces.
latinIntro.cn: caper「山羊」词根从黄道图一路延伸到小提琴炫技曲。

items.exampleCN: 像山羊一样蹦跳（拉丁语用例示意）。
幻想题材画作（意大利语用例示意）。

latinEntries.exampleCN: 林间之羊（拉丁语用例示意）。
